messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The Dune team owns the reporting service.
- [2025-04-04] handover/2025-04-04-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. The Boreal team kept it until today.
- [2025-06-19] handover/2025-06-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: team Dune. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The notifier lives with Boreal. The webhooks service lives with Boreal.
- [2025-04-08] standup/dune/2025-04-08: Reminder that the reporting service depends on the ledger.
- [2025-03-10] standup/dune/2025-03-10: The reports pipeline depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas/2025-03-10: Dependency map update: the billing service needs the ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2: Atlas saw that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it. The Atlas team noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2: New dependency for billing-api: feature-flags. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: For the record, scheduler is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-01-17] standup/boreal/2025-01-17: The notification service depends on the bus for delivery events. If the event bus is down, the webhook dispatcher is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-02-27] standup/boreal/2025-02-27: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation. Team Boreal noticed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. The Boreal team no longer owns it.
- [2025-03-31] handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway: Ownership change: the auth gateway now sits with the Boreal team. Team Ember no longer owns it.
- [2025-08-29] handover/2025-08-29-scheduler: Ownership change: the scheduler now sits with team Cinder. Ember no longer owns it.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-05-26] handover/2026-05-26-billing-api: Ownership change: billing-api now sits with the Dune team. Boreal no longer owns it.
- [2026-02-04] standup/dune/2026-02-04-2: As before, the webhook dispatcher needs the event bus to work. Reminder: webhooks is owned by team Dune.
- [2025-09-05] handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-08-29: the scheduler went to Atlas, not team Cinder. Team Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-02-11] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Review of INC-2025-004 (the notifier, 2025-02-06). The root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. We decided that notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-06-12] standup/dune/2025-06-12: The Dune team noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2025-01-16] standup/dune/2025-01-16: First on-call rotation for team Dune goes to Farah Haddad.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar Lind is on call for the Ember team to start the year.
- [2025-01-14] standup/cinder/2025-01-14: Yuki takes the first team Cinder on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: For the record, the event bus is owned by Boreal.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18-2: The Ember team noticed that auth-gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19-2: Team Ember noticed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2026-06-18] standup/ember/2026-06-18: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08: The Boreal team on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns the service the notifier depends on?

Step 1: What service does the notifier depend on? From memory: [2025-01-17] standup/boreal/2025-01-17: "The notification service depends on the bus for delivery events." So the notifier depends on the bus (event bus).

Step 2: Who owns the event bus? 
- [2025-01-09]: event bus owned by Boreal.
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. Boreal no longer owns it.
- [2026-05-04]: "Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days... Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks." This mentions the event-bus retention but doesn't change ownership. It says Boreal still owns catalog service.

No later ownership change for event bus, so as of now (2026-06-30), the event bus is owned by Atlas team.

- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas: Atlas saw notifier memory growth... Atlas team noticed resizer cold start... no on-call person mentioned.
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas: dependency map... no on-call.

On-call mentions:
- Boreal: Marcus Oyelaran (2025-02-27), Marcus (2025-09-08)
- Dune: Farah Haddad (2025-01-16)
- Ember: Oskar Lind (2025-01-14), Diego (2026-06-18)
- Cinder: Yuki (2025-01-14)
